subject: general
question: Recently the Government of India has raised the age of marriage for girls to 21. What is the benefit of following this law?

options.text: It will ensure girls have reached puberty.
It will help couples to be financially independent.
It will slow down population growth.

solution:
The correct answer is that __**It will discourage teen pregnancies**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary benefits of raising the age of marriage for girls to 21 **are related to improving women's health, education, and overall well-being.**
 
• **It will discourage teen pregnancies**:
 
 
• This is one of the significant benefits.
 
• By **delaying marriage, the law can reduce the likelihood of early pregnancies, which often carry health risks for both mothers and babies.**
 
• It can also encourage girls to focus on education and career opportunities before starting a family.
